_source: owner brief: IL FORNAIO / the cheerful baker (docs/wayfinder/evidence/fornaio-special.md)
_tool: hand-written overlay (tools/character/extract_reference_catalogue.py extracts the FROZEN six into reference_catalogue.json and must never learn about this file)
_note: Godot-only special athletes. A port addition has no row in `js/data.js`, so it can never appear in `Frozen.athletes`, `OutfitCatalogue.athlete_ids()` or `Config.selectable_athletes()` — those stay the reference's six (tests/game_slice_test.gd pins the count). This overlay is the ONE place a special's facts live; `src/character/specials.gd` only reads it. A DEMO build does not offer the set at all (`Specials.selectable(true)` is empty): the reference's own DEMO_CONTENT cannot list an addition, exactly as the world arenas cannot. Outfit colours are one base pair from the DNA: white jacket #f7f4ee as the primary family and amber #d98e2b as the trim family — the same two-family mapping reference_catalogue.json uses (see its `anchors`).

specials.name: IL FORNAIO
